# Technical Design Review Template

Use this template for technical proposals and design reviews.

## Title
Short, descriptive title for the design.

## Context and Problem Statement
What problem are we solving? Why is this needed now?

## Goals and Non-Goals
List expected outcomes and what is out of scope.

## Proposed Design / Approach
High-level overview and diagrams. Include key components and data flows.

## Alternatives Considered
List alternatives and reasons for rejection.

## Impact and Risks
Performance, security, operational, and team risks.

## Rollout / Migration Plan
How to deploy safely, backwards compatibility, and migration steps.

## Testing and Validation
How the change will be tested (unit, integration, load, e2e) and acceptance criteria.

## Rollback Plan
If something goes wrong, how do we revert? Who owns it?

## Open Questions
Any unresolved decisions requiring input from reviewers.

## Reviewers
- [ ] Technical Lead / Architect
- [ ] QA Lead
- [ ] Product Manager
- [ ] Devs impacted by change

Instructions:
- Link this template from RFCs and PRs. Fill sections relevant to the change and provide diagrams or small code examples where useful.
